ai.betaHint: The assistant is still in testing — answers can be off.
ai.diaryHint: Your diary is the most personal part here, and it goes to an external service along with the rest. If you're unsure, leave it off.

intro.title: Your companion
intro.body: It reads your habits, check-ins and mood, and writes you a short letter each week — what went well, what slipped, and one thing it noticed.

consent.title: The assistant
consent.sees: What it sees: habit names, check-ins and mood. Diary entries — only if you allow it.

reflection.emptyHint: Track a few days and the assistant will have something to write about.

quota.resets: The limit resets tomorrow — your letter will be waiting.

settings.title: AI assistant
settings.description: A weekly letter about your habits and mood, plus gentle notices on the dashboard.

lowMoodStreak.v0: {{count}} days in a row with a low mood. Want to talk, or just rest?
lowMoodStreak.v1: Mood has been low {{count}} days running. No pressure — just noticing.
lowMoodStreak.v2: That's {{count}} quiet days in a row. Anything you'd want to put into words?

comeback.v0: You're back after {{days}} days away. That's the hard part done.
comeback.v1: {{days}} days off, and here you are again. Good to see.
comeback.v2: Back after a {{days}}-day break — starting again counts.

streakBroken.v0: {{habit}}: a {{run}}-day run ended {{daysAgo}} days ago. Streaks break; the habit doesn't have to.
streakBroken.v1: {{habit}} hasn't been checked for {{daysAgo}} days — before that, {{run}} in a row. Start a new one?
streakBroken.v2: A {{run}}-day run on {{habit}} stopped {{daysAgo}} days ago. One day is enough to begin again.

synergyFound.v0: On {{habitA}} days you also do {{habitB}} {{pct}}% of the time — against {{usualPct}}% usually.
synergyFound.v2: When {{habitA}} happens, {{habitB}} follows {{pct}}% of the time ({{usualPct}}% otherwise).

perfectWeek.v0: {{days}} perfect days in a row. Every habit, every day.

placeholder.log: What did you get to today?

checkin.moodNeeded: Pick a mood — the diary entry can't be saved without one

rejected.outsideWeek: {{detail}} is outside this week — only the current week can be edited
rejected.futureDate: {{detail}} is in the future — it can't be logged ahead
rejected.unknownHabit: No such habit — you can create it on the Dashboard

opener.checkin: I'd like to say more about my day.

address.label: How should we address you?
address.hint: Ukrainian verbs carry grammatical gender when addressing someone. This is only about word forms — you can change it any time.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.emailHint: Email cannot be changed for now.
profile.avatarHint: JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB.

avatarError.decode: Could not read that image. Try another one.

profile.error: Could not save your profile. Please try again.

accent.title: Accent color
accent.description: Choose the accent palette used across the app.

tableLayout.title: Table layout
tableLayout.description: How the habit table is arranged (week and month).
tableLayout.proHint: Choosing a layout is a Pro feature.

statWidgets.title: Statistics widgets
statWidgets.description: Choose which metrics and widgets to show on the Statistics page.

planner.tasksPerLine: One task per line. Enter starts a new one.
planner.deleteCardConfirm: Delete "{{name}}" and all its {{count}} tasks? This can't be undone.
planner.archivedEmpty: No past days with tasks yet.

activeEmpty.title: Nothing planned
activeEmpty.subtitle: Add a task to start planning your day.

form.subtitle: Add a time range for a schedule item, or leave it blank for a to-do.
form.title: Title
form.titlePlaceholder: Type a title or pick a habit
form.titleHint: Start typing — we'll suggest your habits.
form.timeHint: Leave times empty to add it to the to-do list.
form.timeRange: End time must not be before start time.

habits.resizeColumn: Resize the Habit column (drag, or double-click to reset)
habits.empty: Add your first habit to start tracking.

form.subtitle: Name it — the icon is picked automatically.
form.name: Name
form.freqWeeklyHint: Counts as done when you hit it {{count}}× in a Mon–Sun week — any days.
form.freqHoursHint: Timed habit — log minutes each day; the cell shows hours. Goal: {{hours}}h in a Mon–Sun week.
form.proHint: Color and icon are set automatically. Upgrade to Pro to customize them.

delete.title: Delete habit?
delete.description: "{{name}}" will be moved to Trash. You can restore it within 7 days.
delete.descriptionImmediate: Permanently delete "{{name}}" and all its check-ins? This can't be undone.

trash.title: Trash
trash.description: Deleted habits stay here for 7 days, then they're gone for good.

time.title: Time spent
time.info: Total time logged per timed habit over the period, its split across habits, and your average per active day.
time.empty: No time logged yet. Create an “Hours/week” habit and log minutes on the tracker.

synergy.title: Habit synergies
synergy.info: On days you do the first habit, how often you also do the second — vs your usual rate. Reveals which habit pulls the others up.
synergy.empty: Not enough data yet — keep a few habits going together and patterns will show up.

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.info: Personal records and upcoming milestones, based on your streaks and perfect days.
milestones.empty: Start a streak and your milestones will appear here.
milestones.newRecordSub: {{count}} days in a row — your longest ever
milestones.newRecordSub_week: {{count}} weeks in a row — your longest ever
milestones.comebackSub: Back on track after {{count}} days off

activity.title: Activity over time
activity.info: Percentage of habits completed for each day of the period. Hover a point to see the value.

heatmap.title: Year in review
heatmap.locked: The yearly heatmap is a Pro feature.
heatmap.info: Each cell is a day of the year; the darker it is, the higher the share of habits completed that day.

mood.title: Mood & habits
mood.completionUp: You tend to feel better on days when you complete most of your habits.
mood.completionDown: You tend to feel better on lighter days, when you complete fewer of your habits and rest.
mood.completionFlat: Your mood barely depends on how many habits you complete.
mood.completionBasis: Based on {{count}} days with a logged mood.
mood.empty: Not enough data yet — log your mood for a few more days (we need at least 5 days both with and without a habit done).
mood.higher: Higher average mood on days you do this
mood.lower: Lower average mood on days you do this
mood.disclaimer: Shows mood linked to habits, not what causes it.
mood.info: Compares average mood on days a habit was done vs days it wasn't.

empty.title: No stats yet
empty.hint: Add a habit and start checking it off to see your statistics.

progress.title: Progress
progress.info: Compares this period's metrics with the previous window of the same length (e.g. the last 30 days vs the 30 before).
progress.notForAll: Pick week, month or year to see the change vs the previous period.
progress.notEnough: Not enough history to compare with the previous period.

insight.up: This period is clearly better than the last — keep it up!
insight.down: This period is weaker than the last. A small step today gets the momentum back.
insight.flat: You're holding steady — about the same as the previous period.

movers.title: What changed
movers.info: Habits whose completion rate noticeably rose or fell vs the previous period of the same length.
movers.empty: No notable changes vs the previous period.

weekday.title: Weekdays
weekday.info: The weekdays with the highest and lowest average completion for the selected period.
weekday.empty: Not enough data to compare weekdays yet.

goal.title: Goal
goal.info: Your target completion rate. The ring shows this period's completion progress toward the goal.
goal.prompt: Set a goal to track your progress toward it.

diary.empty: Pick a mood and jot down your thoughts to start your diary.

auth.name: Name
auth.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters
validation.passwordSame: The new password is the same as the current one

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.body: Enter your email and we'll send a link to set a new password.
forgot.sentBody: If an account for {{email}} exists, the link is on its way. It works for one hour.

reset.title: New password
reset.body: Choose a new password. All sessions will end, so you'll need to log in again.
reset.done: Password changed. Log in with the new one.
reset.invalidBody: It has been used already or expired — links work for one hour.

changePassword.title: Password
changePassword.body: Changing it ends every session — including this device.
changePassword.done: Password changed. Log in with the new one.

verify.noticeBody: Your email isn't confirmed yet. Without it, password recovery won't reach you.
verify.doneBody: Password recovery will reach you now, if you ever need it.
verify.failedBody: It has been used already or expired. Send a new one from Settings.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or may have moved.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Invalid data. Please check and try again.
errors.AI_DISABLED: The assistant is turned off. You can enable it in Settings.
errors.AI_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: You've used today's assistant requests. The limit resets tomorrow.
errors.AI_UNAVAILABLE: The assistant is unavailable right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.AI_NOT_ENOUGH_DATA: Not enough tracked days yet for a letter. Keep going for a bit.
